notes.title: Demo available
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that a free demo of BACKROOMS ANOMALY is now available on itch.io! While we continue preparing for the full Steam release, you can get your first taste of the endless corridor and its mysterious anomalies.

Try the demo here: https://liminal-space-dev.itch.io/backrooms-anomaly


The demo lets you experience the core gameplay loop:

- Explore the meticulously crafted looping Backrooms environment
- Test your perception by spotting subtle environmental changes
- Experience the atmospheric sound design and VHS aesthetic

Thank you for your continued interest in BACKROOMS ANOMALY. Your feedback on the demo will help us polish the full version coming to Steam. Don't forget to wishlist if you haven't already!
